pardon_our_dust_modal_body:
As we prepare to enter Enchanted Wilds and transfer to our new engine, TFT will be delivering a patch that's larger than normal. No action is needed on your end; your Riot ID, RP, and Friends List are still shared across League of Legends, and your TFT cosmetics are coming with you. Because we're moving to a new engine, you may notice some differences in models, textures, VFX, or animations in your Tacticians and Arenas, and we'll be continuing to polish things as quickly as possible.

For more detailed information, please visit {{link}}.
